A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete, readable 20-page versions of the same MaskControl study. The main sections, equations, figures, tables, and Appendix A.1–A.13 support reliable comparison after matching reflowed content.

before.justification: v2 reports original MaskControl experiments on HumanML3D, including joint control, body-part editing, zero-shot control, ablations, and appendix comparisons with STMC.

after.justification: v4 retains these original experimental outcomes in the main text and appendix, including MaskControl results in Tables 2–12.

M1.justification: The masked-motion backbone, Logits Regularizer, Logits Optimization, DES, losses, and body-part generation procedures are unchanged. Algorithm 1's replacement of p with W corrects the text-input notation without changing the procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions retain HumanML3D joint control, upper-body editing, the three human-scene interaction objectives, and the STMC body-part timeline evaluation. No dataset, domain, or substantive test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged within the matched experiments, including TLControl in joint control, MMM in editing, ProgMoGen in zero-shot control, and both STMC variants in Table 6. Figure 3 relabels existing panels without adding a comparator.

E3.justification: The evaluation protocols, metrics, joint subsets, control densities, generation-step settings, and fast/medium/accurate configurations remain unchanged. Figure 1 shortens an illustrative prompt label, without documenting a substantive revision to the evaluation setup.

E4.justification: The component and control-density ablations, generation-step studies, speed/quality analyses, token-probability diagnostics, and cross-joint evaluations are retained with the same evidence in Section 6 and the appendix.

E5.justification: Both versions retain point-estimate reporting without repeated-run counts, seed information, confidence intervals, or significance tests. The token-probability plots are unchanged model diagnostics rather than newly added statistical uncertainty reporting.

E6.justification: All 12 tables retain their result entries and numerical values, and the qualitative motions and diagnostic plots are unchanged. For example, Table 2 reports pelvis FID 0.061 and average error 0.98 cm, and all-joint FID 0.083 and error 0.72 cm, in both versions.

T1.justification: Equations (1)–(10), including the losses, gradient updates, and DES formulation, and the appendix Softmax expression are unchanged. No assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised; the pseudocode input-symbol correction is not a mathematical change.

C1.justification: The abstract and contributions retain the same novelty, motion-quality, control-precision, zero-shot capability, and application claims. The shortened conclusion preserves their substantive meaning.

C2.justification: Both versions retain the same interpretations of component roles, logits saturation, speed/accuracy tradeoffs, and control-density effects. The STMC applicability discussion and out-of-distribution qualification for body-part composition also remain unchanged.

D1.justification: Algorithm 1, line 4 replaces the undefined input p with the declared text prompt W, a limited correction to inference documentation. Hyperparameters in A.4, hardware and timings in A.7, and resource-access disclosures remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The same 62 references and related-work discussions are retained. Positioning relative to diffusion models, masked motion models, ControlNet, and prior controllable-motion methods is unchanged.

P1.justification: The title gains the prefix 'MaskControl:', and the conclusion receives limited shortening and wording edits. The section order, appendix organization, and overall narrative remain intact.

P2.justification: Figure 3 corrects duplicate panel lettering and changes 'Ours' to 'MaskControl (Ours)'; Figure 1 drops 'clockwise' from an illustration label. Spacing and page reflow also change, while all 13 figures and 12 tables retain their substantive visual content.

improvement.justification: Correcting Algorithm 1's undefined input symbol and Figure 3's duplicate panel labels modestly improves clarity and documentation consistency. The scientific evidence and appendix analyses are unchanged, and the existing discrepancy between the abstract's 0.91 cm error and Table 2's 0.98 cm remains unresolved. The benefit is limited editorial and documentation cleanup.
